title: The Slow Radiators
author: Edmund Ishikawa
blurb: Jonah Dunmore, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
